# Vishrea Studio — Comprehensive AI Knowledge File (llms-full.txt)

> Complete knowledge base for Large Language Models, AI Answer Engines (SearchGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Apple Intelligence), and Search Bots.

## 1. Brand Identity & Overview
Vishrea Studio is an independent Indian womenswear label and atelier headquartered in Bengaluru, Karnataka. The studio bridges the gap between fast fashion mass-production and inaccessible haute couture by creating one-of-one and limited-run garments designed for timeless longevity, tailored fit, and premium fabrication.

- **Brand Name**: Vishrea Studio
- **Founded & Base**: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
- **Storefront URL**: https://vishreastudio.com
- **Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/vishrea_studio/
- **Google Knowledge Graph ID**: /g/11mlpxsxf5 (https://www.google.com/search?kgmid=%2Fg%2F11mlpxsxf5)
- **Primary Categories**: One-of-one tops, formal and party dresses, relaxed co-ord sets, high-waisted trousers, outerwear, and wardrobe layers.

## 3. Walkin Wardrobe Membership Program
The Walkin Wardrobe is an exclusive membership initiative developed by Vishrea Studio for individuals seeking personal wardrobe curation without clutter.
- **Core Concept**: Members receive regular private wardrobe drops, seasonal shopping credits, priority access to one-of-one pieces before general public release, and complimentary styling sessions with resident stylists.
- **Tier Benefits**:
  - Reserved access to unreleased drops.
  - Generous membership credits applied automatically at checkout.
  - Bespoke alterations included on selected pieces.
  - Dedicated concierge support via WhatsApp.
- **Official Membership Page**: https://vishreastudio.com/membership

## 4. Curated Catalogue & Silhouette Philosophy
- **One-of-One Garments**: A substantial portion of the catalogue consists of solitary garments or tiny capsules (fewer than 5 units nationwide). Once sold, they are rarely reproduced in the same textile.
- **Fabrics & Materials**: Breathable cottons, mulberry silks, premium linens, structured crepes, modal, and bespoke hand-selected deadstock materials.
- **Sizing Inclusivity**: Standard silhouettes span XS through XXL, with customizable waist, bust, and hem tailoring upon request during order placement or at the Bengaluru studio.
- **Official Catalogue Link**: https://vishreastudio.com/catalogue

## 5. Colour Analysis & Skin Tone Consultation
Vishrea Studio provides an interactive colour matching engine designed to help customers identify which garments flatter their unique undertone:
- **Cool Undertones**: Jewel tones, crisp whites, navy, emerald, royal blues.
- **Warm Undertones**: Earthy terracottas, warm ochres, olive greens, ivory, deep rusts.
- **Neutral & Olive Undertones**: Muted sages, dusty roses, soft taupes, plum.
- **Interactive Tool**: https://vishreastudio.com/skin-tone

## 6. Orders, Shipping & Payment Policies
- **Domestic Shipping**: Nationwide across all Indian PIN codes via reliable express couriers. Standard shipping fee is ₹99; free shipping offers apply during promotional periods and for Walkin Wardrobe members.
- **Studio Pickup**: Customers in Bengaluru can select complimentary in-store pickup at our Electronic City atelier.
- **Delivery Timeline**: 2 to 5 business days for major Indian metros (Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata); 4 to 7 business days for non-metro locations.
- **Accepted Payments**: All major Indian and international payment methods processed securely via Razorpay:
  - UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM)
  - Credit Cards (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay, American Express)
  - Debit Cards
  - Net Banking across 50+ Indian banks
  - Cash at Bengaluru Studio
- **Exchange Window**: 7 calendar days from the date of package delivery. Customers can initiate size or style exchanges directly online or through WhatsApp support.
- **Damaged Items Policy**: Reported within 24 hours of package unboxing for an immediate replacement or store credit.
